pricing.description: Perfect for testing and small projects

pricing.name: Basic
pricing.description: Ideal for startups and growing applications

pricing.name: Pro

endpoints.name: Health Check
endpoints.description: API health check and status information

endpoints.name: Get All States
endpoints.description: Returns list of all US states with their codes

endpoints.name: Get Case Types
endpoints.description: Returns list of available case types

endpoints.name: Get Injury Types
endpoints.description: Returns list of available injury types

endpoints.name: Get Statute of Limitations
endpoints.description: Returns statute of limitations in years for a specific state and case type

parameters.name: caseType
parameters.description: Case type: personal-injury, property-damage, wrongful-death, medical-malpractice

endpoints.name: Get All Case Types for State
endpoints.description: Returns statute of limitations for all case types in a specific state

endpoints.name: Get Average Settlement
endpoints.description: Returns average settlement range for a specific injury type

parameters.name: injuryType

endpoints.name: Get All Settlements
endpoints.description: Returns average settlement data for all injury types

documentation.overview: The Legal Data API provides comprehensive legal information for developers building legal tech applications. Get accurate statute of limitations data for all 50 US states and average settlement ranges for common personal injury cases.
